description: The single-decision screen made literal, and the reference the rest of the forms family is measured against. One subject, one input, nothing else competing.

MUST: Accept a paste of the whole code, and accept platform autofill.
Advance and retreat between boxes as digits are entered and deleted, without the user managing focus.
Adopt destructive on error, and fire the error haptic at the same moment.
Take the content voice with tabular figures — a code the user types is content, not a machine string.
Announce its resend timer at start, halfway and zero rather than every second.
SHOULD: Autofocus, because this is a screen whose single subject is an input — one of the few places autofocus is right.
Grow the boxes with text scale and wrap the row on compact widths.
NEVER: Render the code in the monospace register. Mono is for strings the user reads, not ones they type.
Show a countdown that updates a live region every second.
Clear every box on a single wrong digit.
